import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,re,subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd(); ids=set(json.loads((p/'reservation.json').read_text())['ids']); out=[]
base=p.parents[1]/'lanes/pi-mathdb-full-corpus-inventory-r301/corpus'
print('BASE',base)
for f in sorted(base.glob('mathdb-normalized-chunk-*.jsonl')):
 b=f.read_bytes(); found=[]
 for i,line in enumerate(b.splitlines(keepends=True),1):
  o=json.loads(line); ident=o.get('mathdb_id',o.get('id'))
  if ident not in ids: continue
  print('RECORD',ident,json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False))
  found.append((i,line,o))
 for i,line,o in found:
  m=re.search(rb'"statement"\s*:\s*("(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*")',line); assert m
  token=m.group(1); decoded=json.loads(token).encode()
  out.append(dict(id=o.get('mathdb_id',o.get('id')),chunk=str(f),chunk_sha256=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),line=i,raw_line=line.decode(),raw_sha256=hashlib.sha256(line).hexdigest(),newline=line.endswith(b'\n'),statement_token=token.decode(),token_sha256=hashlib.sha256(token).hexdigest(),statement=decoded.decode(),statement_sha256=hashlib.sha256(decoded).hexdigest()))
assert len(out)==20
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'originals.json'],input=json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True); assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
